description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for Postscript-specific (Type 1 and Type 2) glyph hints recorders used in the FreeType font rendering library. It includes function pointer types, opaque handle types, and API structures for creating, configuring, and applying hints to font glyphs.

methods.name: PSH_Globals_NewFunc
methods.description: Creates a new global hints recorder with specified memory and private dictionary.

methods.name: PSH_Globals_SetScaleFunc
methods.description: Sets scaling and translation for the global hints recorder.

methods.name: T1_Hints_OpenFunc
methods.description: Prepares a Type 1 hints recorder for a new recording session.

methods.name: T1_Hints_SetStemFunc
methods.description: Records a horizontal or vertical stem hint for Type 1.

methods.name: T1_Hints_SetStem3Func
methods.description: Records three counter-controlled stems at once for Type 1.

methods.name: T1_Hints_ResetFunc
methods.description: Resets stem hints in a recording session.

methods.name: T1_Hints_CloseFunc
methods.description: Closes a Type 1 hints recording session.

methods.name: T1_Hints_ApplyFunc
methods.description: Applies recorded hints to a glyph outline for Type 1.

methods.name: T2_Hints_OpenFunc
methods.description: Prepares a Type 2 hints recorder for a new recording session.

methods.name: T2_Hints_MaskFunc
methods.description: Sets a hint mask for Type 2.

methods.name: T2_Hints_CounterFunc
methods.description: Sets a counter mask for Type 2.

methods.name: T2_Hints_CloseFunc
methods.description: Closes a Type 2 hints recording session.

methods.name: T2_Hints_ApplyFunc
methods.description: Applies recorded hints to a glyph outline for Type 2.

methods.name: get_globals_funcs
methods.description: Retrieves functions for global hints management from a module.

methods.name: get_t1_funcs
methods.description: Retrieves functions for Type 1 hints management from a module.

methods.name: get_t2_funcs
methods.description: Retrieves functions for Type 2 hints management from a module.
